why_bm_a: bm-b could not claim anything (R13-3: its HEAD is not an ancestor of origin/main, so pull --ff-only always fails and no card reaches it). bm-a had whisper+torch-cuda ready and 11.8GB free VRAM, so the work ran where capacity existed instead of waiting out a repair window.
evidence: anchors/<song>.json (whisper words) for all 41 album tracks
anchors/<song>-calibrated.json + .txt (official 词面 x word timing)
lyrics/<song>.lrc + .txt (official lyric library; source URL in each header)
known_bounds: 2 songs needed a second lyric source: 163 search returns only covers for several album tracks, so QQ Music is used with self-verifying [ti:]/[ar:周杰伦] tags.
「对不起」 official lyric is titled 「对不起 (统一茶饮料 广告曲)」 - the song WAS a 统一 jingle later included on 范特西; accepted by title-prefix + artist tag, not by exact equality.
whisper 'small' model: word timing is good, sung text is NOT the official lyric (that is what calibration is for). Any downstream 对嘴 must use calibrated files.

BPM comes from librosa beat_track (surface: assumed 4/4) and can read half-tempo on fast tracks - re-measured 龙拳=92.3 vs 416 beats/274.6s (=90.8), so the stored number is faithful to the engine, not a pipeline bug; any bar-based shot length downstream must verify the feel before trusting bars.
